summary: Audited experiment.py (sweeps, batch velocity, CSV run config, guards). Fixed 2 guard defects: (1) run_sweep_2d validated int(n_speed)<2 even when an explicit speeds array was passed (n_speed is then ignored -> spurious error) while a 1-element speeds array slipped through unguarded; now it validates the effective speed grid (>=2 finite values) and only checks n_speed when speeds is None. (2) run_sweep_mp lacked the release_pos-finite, speed-finite-positive, and JITTER_SHOTS>0 guards that run_sweep has, so bad inputs failed only inside spawned workers; added the same guards before ProcessPoolExecutor. Verified: python -c 'import experiment' OK; py_compile OK (only __pycache__ write denied by sandbox); python test_experiment.py = 6 pass + 2 pre-existing tempfile cleanup PermissionErrors (environment artifact, unchanged); python test_core.py = 13/13; tiny 3x3 sweep reproducible (P bit-identical for same seed) and 3D CSV columns/row-count/no-duplicate-cells/p_make==p_swish+p_rim_in+p_board_in verified; numeric before/after probes identical (no drift). Not fixed (report-only): batch_simulate inline collision vs collision.resolve_contacts divergence (cross-file, integrator call); run_sweep_mp/docstring minor inaccuracies.
